60788839.displaySource:
"Eris did something truly kind for me, however, in those final moments. When she found me strung up, I saw her clutching the trinket I had made her—the one she'd rejected—tightly against her chest. I never forgot that. She'd made sure in that moment that the fire in my heart didn't go out. Made sure I knew I wasn't alone. The fire in me raged. What I would've given to stand with my fireteam one last time and burn those heathens to oblivion!"

—A loyal friend

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.

The next lesson is that of control. In order to wield Stasis effectively, it must become an extension of your will.

Discipline your mind, and you'll make this dark power yours, instead of the other way around.

The next Crux is located in the heart of House Salvation's territory. The enemies you face there will attack with the rage of the affronted. Focus your abilities with firm resolve so that the battle plays out exactly as you see fit.

Seals: [Stasis: Glyph 0] [Stasis: Glyph 1 Locked] [Stasis: Glyph 2 Locked] [Stasis: Glyph 3 Locked]

Guard your emotions against the temptations of the Darkness as well as your own fear in wielding it. This will help you resist any attack on or off the battlefield. Put that into practice when you find the next Crux.

Now that you've accepted this weighty responsibility, find your way to a Crux of Darkness. Commune with it. It will give you a taste of what lies ahead on this path.

By reactivating the Vex portal built by Clovis Bray, Eramis endangered all life on Europa, including her own soldiers' lives. Though you successfully thinned the Vex hordes, Eramis was still able to collect the radiolarian fluid she needed and escape. 

What she plans to do with this resource is not yet clear. What is clear is that the Darkness has fueled her anger into a reckless rage. She must be stopped once and for all. The time has come to complete your journey with Stasis.

It's time to demonstrate your newfound skills in a much more impactful way. The Exo Stranger mentioned the members of Eramis's dark council each hold their own Splinters of Darkness. Variks will know where to find them.

Devrim nods approvingly at your scratched and spattered armor.

"I've been watching you battle back Maya's forces. Impressive stuff. With a sustained effort like that, we may even be able to resettle the Plaguelands someday."

His optimistic tone becomes tempered by years of war fatigue.

"But I still don't think we've gotten to the bottom of Maya's ambitions in the region. Keep working with Caiatl's Psions to learn what her endgame is with all this Golden Age tech."

The sniper gives you a jaunty salute. "Keep up the good work, Guardian."

3179417205.displaySource:
You've helped Maya and Chioma untangle the secrets of the VexNet's structure. Explorers to the end, they're planning to take their research and use it to track down the Conductor, wherever she is and whatever she's doing.

"We must rally the other exploratory teams, and we must stop the Conductor before she kills again. She may not be me, but I recognize myself in her. I owe it to Chioma to stop her." There's deep pain in Maya's voice. "I owe it to myself."

"So, you're being self-serving," Chioma jokes, in an attempt to lighten the mood.

The Conductor is somewhere out there. The Echo's slow failure hasn't stopped her. Maybe the exploratory teams will find her next; maybe you will. All any of you know is that your work has not yet ended.

Before they set out on their next journey, Maya and Chioma offer you the fruits of your shared labor.

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.

displayProperties.description: A light shines on your path. But you have yet to bring it into focus. Until then, your path remains among the lost.
displayProperties.name: The Journey

3710486535.displaySource:
"For me, there was no return from Crota. I lacked hope. Made me not the easiest to get along with. I knew that. But it didn't matter to Eris. She saw hope in me where I wouldn't. Wanted to say thanks, so I tried to gift her a trinket, but she rejected it. Eris wasn't looking for gratitude; she truly saw hope in us all. On our own, we were nothing. But as she'd always remind us, lost as we might be, true strength came from our union.

"Eris's words rang in my ears as the Hive tore my Light from my soul."

—A loyal friend

displayProperties.description: Around you… darkness. If you are to discover your path, you must anchor yourself to light.
displayProperties.name: The Journey

3715926175.displaySource:
"It was hard to see the point of a single fireteam taking on Crota, but it was easy to understand how retribution had driven us there. The names of everyone we'd lost in that needless disaster were etched across the walls of the Last City, each and every one a reminder that they were gone and we were not. So when Eriana-3 came knocking, it was a simple decision. From top to bottom, we'd avenge every one of those names. A fire burned in all six of us. We were gonna make sure Crota knew it."

—A loyal friend

setData.questStepSummary: "The Exodus Black has become a site of interest for unpartnered Ghosts hoping to resurrect a Golden Age pioneer as their Guardian. But something tells me that's not why Bean is out there." —Micah-10

displayProperties.name: Legacy: Beyond Light

4224533134.displaySource: "Eliksni once made marvels to rival your Golden Age. When you fight them, you do not just fight scavengers… but inventors. Creators. Architects." —Variks the Loyal

setData.questStepSummary: Ghost is now able to locate Praksis's latest experiment. He has created an artificial Vex conflux to lure and trap the Vex. If you disrupt his experiment, Praksis might show himself.

displayProperties.description: Visit Variks in Charon's Crossing.

4224767086.displaySource: "I've said it before: the Darkness can't be trusted. But it can be controlled. I know it." —The Exo Stranger

displayProperties.description: In an Empire Hunt at Advanced difficulty or higher, defeat the boss and defeat combatants with Sidearms.
displayProperties.name: Europa Sidearm

4224767087.displaySource: "We are not the first to reckon with the Darkness, and we won't be the last. There is a lot to learn from all the other places the Darkness has visited." —The Exo Stranger

setData.questStepSummary: Targe's sacrifice and Zavala's vision have illuminated our path forward.

setData.questStepSummary: "Those secure caches the Vex leave behind? They're locked with paraquantum encryption, so you'll need a subroutine passcode ripped right out of a command unit." —Quinn

displayProperties.description:
This Essence has been cleansed but cannot yet be transformed into a piece of Dreambane armor.

Work with Eris Morn to find a solution.

4236522410.displaySource: "Trauma is an unrelenting beast. It never quite leaves our side. But that doesn't mean we owe it a damn thing." —Eris Morn

setData.questLineDescription: Learn how Guardians become more powerful and strengthen your connection to the Light.
setData.questStepSummary:
Shaw Han led you true. You communed with the Traveler and received its lesson. With the help of Maeve's Light that you recovered, you have become stronger.

 Where will you find the next step of your journey?

4265122765.displaySource: "The isolated let their worst thoughts seep into their very being. They convince themselves they are right, because the world around them is so very small. Isolation finds only the worst in us." —Eris Morn
